name: Caldwell
gaps: Parcels are NCOnemap NCOneMap Parcels (CAMA + polygons) (https://gis.caldwellcountync.org/arcgis/rest/services/NCOnemap/NCOneMap/FeatureServer/45). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Source query returned 8142 rows; 8109 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.
